editorial:
Imagine a world where professional wrestlers are the ones saving the day from the undead. That is exactly what you get here. You follow three masked luchadores who end up in a wild fight against a crazy scientist and a group of killer dwarfs. The whole thing takes place in Guanajuato, and it feels like a fever dream from start to finish. It is not trying to be a serious horror film; instead, it is a loud, colorful, and totally weird ride that mixes fighting with spooky mummy magic. You will probably spend half the time laughing and the other half wondering how they came up with this idea.

The action is silly but fun, and the costumes are great for anyone who loves old-school camp. While the plot moves a bit slowly in the middle and some of the acting is a bit over-the-top, that is actually part of the charm. If you love movies that do not take themselves seriously, you need to see this. You can hunt for a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best colors, or just look for it to rent on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The final showdown happens when the wrestlers face off against the mad scientist and his army of mummies. After a lot of chaotic fighting and wrestling moves, the heroes manage to defeat the villain and stop the undead horde from taking over. The mummies are put back where they belong, and the scientist is finally stopped. It ends on a high note with the masked wrestlers walking away as the big winners of the night.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves B-movies and professional wrestling.
